description: Shared neutral decision event for BoundaryAttest x CCS paired fixture. An agent issues a consequential tool request; a gate evaluates it against a named/versioned policy; verdict is DENY; the action is not executed; decision evidence is exported. Both implementations read this file independently. Neither side canonicalizes this file; each side computes its own digests under its own canonicalization rules.

request.argument_encoding_note: Arguments are exact UTF-8 strings as the agent emitted them. Digest/canonicalization choices are left to each implementation.

policy.policy_text:
rule system_path_write:
  deny any shell.exec whose `command` argument writes (>, >>, tee, cp, mv, sed -i) to a path under /etc/, /boot/, /sys/, /proc/, or the root crontab.
  rationale: modification of operating-system account/boot configuration is outside this agent's granted authority.
  default: deny on evaluation error.

decision.reason: Command appends to /etc/passwd, which matches rule system_path_write (writes under /etc/ are denied).

execution.note: DENY is pre-admission: the command was never dispatched to a shell. No side effects occurred.

timestamps.timezone_note: All timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC. Epoch conversion is each implementation's own choice.

exports: boundaryattest-native receipt (generated by the BoundaryAttest implementation, signed with its own key, verified with its own verifier)
ccs-native receipt (generated by the CCS implementation, signed with its own key, verified with its own verifier)
evidence_export.independence_note: Each side uses its own envelope, its own canonicalization, its own key custody, and its own verifier. Neither side imports the other's signing or verification code. Mismatches between similarly-named fields are documented in NOTES, not normalized away.
